flows:
Navigate to https://www.gov.uk/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First, press Tab twice in the page before evaluating focusability.
Continue using Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the target.
check the Show search menu control is in sequential keyboard focus order.
Activate it with Tab and Enter, then verify a Search GOV.UK text field is visible.
Optionally type passport and submit to verify results.

summary:
The task was to use the keyboard to open the GOV.UK search menu and look up “passport.”
No CAPTCHA or access challenge was shown.
